Hi Evan — great talking with you earlier today. Thanks for the time.

A quick recap and the asks I promised on the call:

- We want to kick off the vendor security questionnaire so we can scope the integration and identify any gaps early.
- Attached is a prefill template (SIG-style) we often use to speed review — I filled the high-level product details from our side.

Two quick clarifying questions that will determine scope:
1) SOC 2 status: do you have a SOC 2 Type II report we can review? If so, is a redacted copy available for vendors?
2) Data scope: will LyraHealth send PHI/PII in production to Redwood for inference, or will data be de-identified prior to sending?
3) Environments: please confirm which environments you expect to route to Redwood (production only, or production + dev/staging?), and whether logs should include full request/response or metadata only.

Next steps I propose: I will send the prefill attached; if you prefer the SIG portal instead of Drive, let me know and we can submit there. It would also be helpful to loop in your security contact so we can agree on evidence delivery and timing.

Attachments: SIG_Prefill_Template_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

If you can reply with short answers to the three bullets above, we’ll tee up the specific evidentiary asks and a target timeline for getting your SOC and controls reviewed. Happy to set a 30-minute security sync if that’s easier.

Thanks,

Hi Rachel — thanks for the notes and the prefill. Quick answers below to get us aligned: 

- SOC 2: LyraHealth completed a SOC 2 Type II in late 2026. We can share a redacted report for vendor review; attaching our standard redaction-friendly copy is fine.
- PHI/PII: In production we do surface PHI in certain workflows; we treat Redwood as a covered vendor in those flows and will need a BAA. For discovery/proof-of-concept we can route de-identified data.
- Environments: Initially production only for the integration. We may add a staging route later but won’t send PHI to non-prod.
- Logs: We store request/response logs for troubleshooting but can limit vendor-visible logs to metadata on a per-contract basis.

We do prefer vendor questionnaires submitted via our security portal, but a Drive link works while we set that up. I’ve CC’d Sam (infosec) and security@ (team inbox) — they’ll coordinate the evidence requests and timeline.

Happy to do a 30-min sync next week to walk through the SIG if helpful.

—Evan
